rules.name: all_layers_sparse_attention
rules.rule: Every layer must use sparse attention.

rules.name: block_size_equals_sparse_block_size
rules.rule: --block-size must equal sparse_block_size (128); pinned when unset.

rules.name: min_tp_equals_num_kv_heads
rules.rule: --tensor-parallel-size >= num_key_value_heads (4).

rules.name: allowed_kv_cache_dtypes
rules.rule: --kv-cache-dtype in {auto, bfloat16, fp8, fp8_e4m3, int4_per_token_head}; index keys use the KV dtype.

rules.name: no_pcp
rules.rule: PCP > 1 is rejected.

rules.name: no_pp
rules.rule: PP > 1 is rejected.

rules.name: dcp_tp_group_divisibility
rules.rule: DCP must divide TP and divide or be a multiple of replicas = TP // num_key_value_heads; contiguous rank placement.
rules.verbatim: if tp_size % dcp or (replicas % dcp and dcp % replicas):

rules.name: dcp_interleave_size
rules.rule: Under DCP > 1, --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size equals sparse_block_size (128) and prefix match unit stays 128.

rules.name: dspark_disable_hybrid_kv_manager
rules.rule: dspark requires --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager under DCP > 1 (hooks.py) and unconditionally with host KV offload skip_draft_kv (raiden_store.py).

rules.name: dspark_companion_draft_config
rules.rule: Speculative method must be dspark using checkpoint dspark/config.json.

rules.name: dspark_draft_kv_dtype_and_dcp
rules.rule: Draft is 5 dense layers; its sliding-window (4096) KV uses fp8 when target KV is int4_per_token_head and otherwise target KV dtype; sharded over DCP.

rules.name: kv_heads_per_rank_under_dcp
rules.rule: kv_heads_per_rank = max(1, dcp // max(1, tp // num_key_value_heads)); KV row width = 2 * head_dim * kv_heads_per_rank.

rules.name: int4_page_and_scale_layout
rules.rule: 4-bit page shape (blocks, tokens // 8 + scale row, 4, row_width); index page folds 4B f32 scale per token; one f32 scale page [pages, 8, 128] (4096B = 32B/tok) per layer.

rules.name: msa_topk_selection_and_verify_tile
rules.rule: Indexer scores visible blocks, forces local block, keeps topk=16 blocks per KV head; decode dspark verify has 8 query rows (7 draft + 1 current) tiled at SMALL_BATCH_BLOCK_Q=8 sharing fetched pages once.

rules.name: mxfp8_block_alignment
rules.rule: MXFP8 linears require per-rank input dimension to be a multiple of the 32-element MXFP8 block.

rules.name: moe_layer_freq_dense_vs_moe
rules.rule: Layers 0..2 are dense MLPs (dense_intermediate_size=12288); layers 3..59 are MoE (128 routed + 1 shared).

rules.name: index_key_cache_replication
rules.rule: Index-key cache is replicated per rank by default; TP sharding applies only at tp == num_key_value_heads with dcp == 1 and non-4-bit KV (not enumerated).

rules.name: dp_lockstep_and_ep
rules.rule: DP lockstep requires enable_expert_parallel (tpu_runner.py:3738); non-EP workers collapse pc.data_parallel_size = 1 (tpu_worker.py:235). Fail-closed: dp_requires_ep=True.

rules.name: dcp_requires_dp1
rules.rule: No dp==1 check in minimax_m3/hooks.py; upstream governs dp>1 + dcp>1. Fail-closed: dcp_requires_dp1=True.

rules.name: disagg_rejected
rules.rule: Stage-3 Raiden rejects un-admitted models; legacy ZMQ-shm assumes uniform kv_caches[0].shape incompatible with heterogeneous KV/index/4-bit scale pages. Fail-closed: disagg=False.

rules.name: fused_ep_w4a8_gate
rules.rule: Fused EP W4A8 MoE engages with USE_MOE_FUSED_EP_KERNEL, MOE_FUSED_EP_ENABLE_W4A8, use_ep, hidden % 128 == 0, max_node_tokens >= 1024; roofline prices cheaper floor and emits no perf-only env.

rules.name: synthetic_verify_one_lm_head_row
rules.rule: TPU_SPEC_SYNTHETIC_ONE_ROW_VERIFY (default True) slices 1 hidden-state logit row per padded request.
rules.verbatim: row to compute logits for, one per padded request."""

rules.name: skip_draft_kv_host_offload
rules.rule: TPURaidenOffloadingConnector subtracts draft_bytes from bytes_per_block_all_ranks so host DRAM holds target KV only.

rules.name: dcp_collectives_floor
rules.rule: DCP kernels run q_all all_gather, candidate ppermute/all_gather, and (out, lse) partial exchange (or remote-DMA exchange_head_pages + scale_cache all_to_all for 4-bit large-token heads_op); L1 omits optional DCP exchange as a lower bound.
